messages.content: What parameters do the viscous friction force depend on, and in which case should it be taken into account for the physical pendulum model? In your response the last word of each sentence must become the first word of the next sentence.

message.content:
The viscous friction force depends on relative velocity, especially angular velocity, and the damping Coefficient.
Coefficient values depend on fluid viscosity, characteristic size, and Shape.
Shape and angular speed determine whether the physical pendulum model needs the viscous Torque.
Torque from viscous damping is included when losses through a fluid are significant.
